name: phitex-instant
description: Instant LaTeX preview: pages update as you type, typeset by PhiTeX in VS Code itself.

markdownEnumDescriptions: The engine inside VS Code (WebAssembly): nothing to install, pages updated as you type.
The `phitex` command's own `phitex watch`: the native engine, faster on large documents; pages updated when a file is saved (turn on auto-save).

phitex.path.description: The phitex command (for the "phitex watch" engine): a name on the PATH or a full path.

phitex.trace.markdownDescription: Write what the preview does (each request, page drawn and event, with its time) to the PhiTeX output: for a bug report.

enumDescriptions: What the project needs: a `% !TEX program = …` comment in its main file, else XeLaTeX when its preamble loads fontspec, unicode-math, polyglossia and the like, else pdfLaTeX.
pdfLaTeX for every project (a `% !TEX program` comment still wins).
XeLaTeX for every project (a `% !TEX program` comment still wins).
phitex.texEngine.markdownDescription: The TeX engine the builtin engine typesets with. A `% !TEX program = …` comment in the main file wins over this. (`phitex watch` chooses its own.)

phitex.main.markdownDescription: The project's main `.tex` file, relative to its folder. Empty: the open file if it has `\documentclass`, else the folder's file that has it.

phitex.threads.markdownDescription: The builtin engine's threads. `0`: one per core of this machine, at most 4 (more are capped at 4 for now).

markdownEnumDescriptions: The words at the cursor are marked on the page, whenever it rests.
Only what you select is marked.
Nothing is marked as you move; a double-click on a page opens its source.
phitex.follow.description: What the pages mark of where you are in the source.

enumDescriptions: Darker pages; it inverts figures and photos too
Dark when VS Code's theme is
A different one each time (PhiTeX's the first time)
An old monitor running phitex watch
A paper plane, folded as the build goes
phitex.opening.description: The loading animation played on the first page's sheet while it is typeset.

phitex.underline.description: A wavy line under what each error and warning is about, on the pages.
